answer_1.quote: Speech-to-speech translation (S2ST) aims at translating speech of one language to speech of another language, breaking the communication barriers between people around the world who speak different languages.
answer_1.outputs: The model generates target speech from source speech in a textless, end-to-end manner using discrete speech units and a vocoder for waveform synthesis.

answer_2.quote: all speech outputs are decoded with the same open-sourced ASR models to compute BLEU with respect to the reference transcribed translations using SACREBLEU
